purpose: Measure point-in-time Kalshi KXTEMP market reaction after the preregistered E390 first-decision-eligible full-station incomplete KWI signal. This is a falsification/evidence gate, not a trading strategy.

signal_definition.availability_time: manifest retrieved_at of the first qualifying snapshot
eligibility: numeric latest_incomplete station temp_f count equals previous latest_complete.contributors
previous latest_complete.t is earlier than target incomplete t
signal_definition.same_target_changes: record as revisions; analyze separately from the primary first signal

market_capture.primary: authenticated read-only Kalshi WebSocket orderbook_delta + trade
market_capture.rest_role: public/read-only diagnostic baseline only; insufficient for second-level repricing claims

analysis.websocket_precondition: recent connection coverage; old unchanged snapshot remains valid until a delta
analysis.reaction_definition: first observed top-of-book/depth fingerprint change OR public trade after signal
fail_closed_conditions: explicit capture gap overlapping analysis window
capture ending before full no-reaction window

independence.do_not_count: same-target revisions as independent primary events

next_gate_if_evidence_sufficient.purpose: Measure actual local signal-to-order-ready latency and compare it to E401 reaction latency before any queue/fill simulation.
next_gate_if_evidence_sufficient.advance_only_if: there is repeatable positive timing headroom after measured local p95 pipeline/network latency; no economic edge is inferred yet

kill_rules: Do not infer market edge from KWI prediction accuracy alone.
Kill/downgrade the market-edge lane if prices consistently reflect the signal before a realistic locally measured order-ready timestamp.
Do not treat REST polling as evidence for sub-second or second-level repricing lag.
Do not rescue a failed timing lane by changing signal eligibility, timing window or reaction definition post hoc; create a new experiment version.
Any gap/sequence ambiguity affecting the event is UNPROVEN, never a favorable fill/lag assumption.
